title: Technology Radar & Component Intake Pipeline — Claude independent thesis
summary_en: Build the Radar as a batch pipeline, not an agent: one GitHub repo, scheduled Actions calling public APIs, static JSON registry, deterministic gates and FAST score. GPT HQ controls it via typed radar-control:v1 issues. Code changes only in a secret-free lab repo via branch and PR with CI evidence; one human merge; Visual pins the tag behind an adapter, ErrorBoundary and flag.
